traits.habitat_notes: Moist to dry woodlands and savannas, desert scrub, grasslands and beaches, on flats, slopes and ledges, in sand, clay, limestone, sandstone or igneous, often rocky soils and crevices, 0-2200 m, southern United States through Mexico, the West Indies and Central America to South America; introduced and weedy in southern Africa and Asia (in China in shaded wet places).

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form chosen from the plant's habit: an erect, fleshy herb with glossy obovate leaves crowded low and a long bare stalk carrying an airy panicle of tiny pink flowers and round red fruit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species.

allometry.note: 0.6 m tall at 2 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: an erect, fleshy herb with glossy obovate leaves crowded low and a long bare stalk carrying an airy panicle of tiny pink flowers and round red fruit.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): stems branched at the base, semiwoody; FNA genus: herbs, stems sometimes suffrutescent.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): herbs annual or perennial; FNA genus perennial.

traits.perennation.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): root few-branched, obconic, thick, skin black-brown, flesh milky white; Wikipedia: tuberous roots.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): herbs 30-100 cm.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): plants to 15 dm; Wikipedia: almost 2 m.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): stems erect.

traits.stem_clump.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): stems branched basally: a few stems from the tuber.

traits.stem_cross_section.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: slender, round stems; no source read says.

traits.stem_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): stems sometimes reddish, slender; a green with a reddish cast, sRGB by eye for the words.

traits.stem_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): glabrous.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): leaves alternate or subopposite.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: alternate leaves spirally set along the stem, crowded below; no source read says.

traits.leaf_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): blade broadly planate, succulent or semisucculent.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): leaves flat, simple.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): leaf blade obovate or obovate-lanceolate; FNA: elliptic to obovate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): apex acute, sometimes retuse, mucronate.

traits.leaf_base_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): base attenuate (Flora of China: narrowly cuneate).

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): margins entire.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): glabrous.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): blade 5-10 cm; FNA: leaves to 12 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): blade 2.5-5 cm wide.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): leaves short-petiolate or subsessile; the 1 cm upper bound is our estimate.

traits.leaf_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: a fresh, slightly glossy mid green, somewhat fleshy; no source read names a colour (cultivars 'Kingwood Gold' and 'Limón' are yellow-green).

traits.stipules.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): axils naked.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences paniculate; Flora of China: panicle terminal or axillary, large, often dichotomous, long peduncled.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): panicle terminal or axillary.

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences paniculate, sometimes nodding.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: the open, branched panicle above the long peduncle about 10-30 cm; Flora of China says large but gives no length.

traits.peduncle_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: Flora of China says long-peduncled, with leaves reduced abruptly beneath the inflorescence (FNA); 10-30 cm is our estimate.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: a large, repeatedly forking panicle carries dozens to over a hundred small flowers and fruits; no source read counts them.

traits.inflorescence_branches.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: a large, often dichotomous panicle (Flora of China); 5-20 branches is our estimate.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): pedicel 5-10 mm; FNA: terete, ± uniformly slender, to 20 mm.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): flowers small, 6-10 mm wide.

traits.perianth.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): sepals (two, by the family) and petals.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): petals 5.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: German Wikipedia, 'Talinum' (read 2026-10-19 through the GBIF species API descriptions, dataset 'German Wikipedia - Species Pages', as de.wikipedia.org itself was blocked; lower trust; our translation): flowers radially symmetric.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): petals 3-6 mm; Flora of China 6-12 mm.

traits.petal_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): petals ovate to suborbiculate; Flora of China: obovate or elliptic.

traits.petal_apex.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): apex rounded, rarely retuse.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): petals red or pink, sometimes orangish, yellowish or purplish; Flora of China: pink or reddish purple. A hot pink; sRGB by eye for the words.

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): sepals ovate to suborbiculate, 2.5-4 mm.

traits.sepal_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): sepals deciduous, sometimes reflexed.

traits.calyx_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): sepals purple-red; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): stamens ca. 15-20; Flora of China (10-)15-20.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): stamens shorter than petals.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): stigmas 3, linear (the genus: 3-carpellate).

traits.style_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): style ca. 2 mm; stigma 3-lobed.

traits.ovary_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): ovary superior.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): capsules.

traits.capsule_valves.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=132245, read 2026-10-19): 3-valved.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): capsules subglobose, sometimes obtusely trigonous.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): capsules 3-5 mm; Flora of China ca. 4 mm, papery.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: the papery capsule turns tan to brown as it dries and opens; no source read names the colour.

traits.fruit_colour_ripening.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: the young capsules are red to orange-red, the 'jewels' of the common name (Wikipedia: tiny, jewel-like fruits); no source read names the colour.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): sepals deciduous; Flora of China: caducous.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): flowering and fruiting Jun-Nov, year-round in s Florida; Flora of China: Jun-Aug.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): flowering and fruiting Jun-Nov.

traits.elevation_min_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): 0-2200 m.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): 0-2200 m.

traits.light.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): woodlands and savannas as well as desert scrub and beaches; Flora of China: escaping to shaded wet places.

traits.moisture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): moist to dry woodlands and savannas, also desert scrub.

traits.soil_texture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): in sand, clay, limestone, sandstone, igneous, often rocky soils and crevices.

traits.habitat_notes.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Talinum paniculatum (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=200007021, read 2026-10-19): habitats and range as given; thought native west of the Mississippi and adventive and weedy to the east.

traits.leaf_succulence.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Talinum paniculatum (read 2026-10-19): leaves semisucculent, flat.

traits.shoot_leaves.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: Flora of China: leaves crowded on the lower stem below a long bare stalk.
